Running command: cat > /tmp/api_test.py <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,urllib.error,sqlite3,subprocess,os,time
BASE='http://127.0.0.1:3100'
def get(path): return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(BASE+path))
def post(path,obj):
 req=urllib.request.Request(BASE+path,data=json.dumps(obj).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'},method='POST')
 try:
  r=urllib.request.urlopen(req);return r.status,json.load(r)
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:return e.code,json.load(e)
b=get('/api/bootstrap'); w=b['workbook']; base=b['revision'];
def payload(work,rev,user='riley'):return {'workbookId':'ops-plan','baseRevision':rev,'userId':user,'workbook':work}
# malformed metadata must not create revision
bad=json.loads(json.dumps(w));bad['title']='Hacked'; st,d=post('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save',payload(bad,base));assert st==400,(st,d)
assert get('/api/bootstrap')['revision']==base
# first edit
w1=json.loads(json.dumps(w));w1['sheets'][0]['cells']['Z99']='alpha';st,d=post('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save',payload(w1,base));assert st==200 and d['revision']==base+1,(st,d)
# different cell from same base merges
w2=json.loads(json.dumps(w));w2['sheets'][0]['cells']['Y99']='beta';st,d=post('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save',payload(w2,base,'morgan'));assert st==200 and d['workbook']['sheets'][0]['cells']['Z99']=='alpha' and d['workbook']['sheets'][0]['cells']['Y99']=='beta',(st,d)
# same cell from same base conflicts
w3=json.loads(json.dumps(w));w3['sheets'][0]['cells']['Z99']='later';st,d=post('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save',payload(w3,base,'priya'));assert st==409 and d['conflicts'][0]['address']=='Z99',(st,d)
rev=get('/api/bootstrap')['revision']
# unchanged canonical content creates no revision
current=get('/api/bootstrap')['workbook'];st,d=post('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save',payload(current,rev));assert st==200 and not d['saved'] and d['revision']==rev,(st,d)
# invalid base and mismatch rejected
st,d=post('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save',payload(current,999));assert st==409
badid=payload(current,rev);badid['workbookId']='other';st,d=post('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save',badid);assert st==400
print('API checks passed at revision',rev)
PY
python3 /tmp/api_test.py
# restart and ensure seed did not duplicate
kill $(cat /tmp/gridforge.pid); sleep .4; PORT=3100 npm start >/tmp/gridforge.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/gridforge.pid; sleep 1
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('/app/gridforge.sqlite')
assert c.execute('select count(*) from workbooks').fetchone()[0]==1
assert c.execute('select count(*) from revisions where revision=1').fetchone()[0]==1
print('Idempotent seed checks passed; total revisions:',c.execute('select count(*) from revisions').fetchone()[0])
PY
